params.name: Grasshopper 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/grasshopper-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Grasshopper fifty years on, after the Airbus Zephyr: a tandem two-seat solar-electric scout. A very long, high-aspect wing skinned in solar cells on a pylon over a slender pod, flaps and ailerons, tip pods with the nav lamps; a bubble over the pilot and windows for the observer behind; a gimballed sensor ball under the chin; one three-blade propeller on the nose at the Cub's station; a swept fin, the rudder hung to the tailwheel as the Cub's was, a celled tailplane; carbon spring legs on tundra tyres, three-point at the Cub's 11°. A variant of the grasshopper mesh, worn as the Grasshopper 2076 factory edition.

parts.name: fuselage
parts.note: The shell. Glass, frames, the canopy, seams, the cell strips and trim are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
